plugins.label: Map Range
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Remap a number from one range into another (e.g. 0–100 °C → 0–1, or sensor raw → percent). Clamps to the output range by default.

properties.label: Value
properties.help: Incoming value to remap

properties.label: Clamp output
properties.help: If on, result stays between out min and out max

plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
  local v, a, b, c, d = {value}, {in_min}, {in_max}, {out_min}, {out_max}
  local span = b - a
  if span == 0 then return c end
  local t = (v - a) / span
  local r = c + t * (d - c)
  if {clamp_out} then
    local lo, hi = math.min(c, d), math.max(c, d)
    if r < lo then r = lo elseif r > hi then r = hi end
  end
  return r
end)()

plugins.label: Lerp
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Linear blend between A and B by T (0 = all A, 1 = all B). T is clamped to 0–1.

properties.label: T (0–1)
properties.help: Blend factor. Wire a percent source and divide by 100 upstream, or use 0–1 directly.

plugins.label: Threshold
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Compare a value to a threshold. Outputs either a boolean-style 0/1, or passes the original value when the condition holds (gate mode). Useful for glow triggers, swap triggers, and alert bands.

properties.label: Output
properties.help: binary → 1 when condition holds. gate → original value when true, else 0. invert_binary flips the 0/1.

properties.label: Equal ε
properties.help: Tolerance used only when Mode is Equal

plugins.label: Deadzone
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Zero-out values whose absolute magnitude is below a threshold. Optional soft ramp so the edge is not a hard cliff. Great for noisy net/CPU deltas and joystick-style inputs.

properties.label: Deadzone
properties.help: Values with |value| < deadzone become 0 (or are scaled in soft mode)

properties.label: Soft edge
properties.help: If on, rescale so the deadzone is removed and the rest maps smoothly outward

plugins.label: Smooth (EMA)
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Exponential moving average — tames jittery sensors (CPU, net, GPU) before they hit rings/bars. Each node needs a unique Slot so parallel smoothers do not share state.

properties.label: Alpha
properties.help: 1 = no smoothing (follow input). Smaller = heavier lag. 0.15–0.3 is a good starting band for CPU/net.

properties.label: Slot
properties.help: Unique integer per Smooth node in the project (1, 2, 3…). Shared slots share the same smoothed memory.

plugins.label: Temp Convert
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Convert temperature between Fahrenheit and Celsius. Wire your weather (or any °F/°C source) in, pick the direction, and feed rings, labels, or thresholds in the unit you want.

properties.label: Temperature
properties.help: Incoming temperature. Accepts a weather/source node that reports °F or °C.

properties.label: Round to
properties.help: Optional rounding so labels stay tidy (e.g. 21.3 instead of 21.333…).

plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
  local v = {value}
  local dir = '{direction}'
  local out
  if dir == 'c_to_f' then
    out = v * 9 / 5 + 32
  else
    out = (v - 32) * 5 / 9
  end
  local d = '{decimals}'
  if d == '0' then return math.floor(out + 0.5)
  elseif d == '1' then return math.floor(out * 10 + 0.5) / 10
  elseif d == '2' then return math.floor(out * 100 + 0.5) / 100
  end
  return out
end)()

plugins.label: Threshold Chain (10-Stage)
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Map one number onto up to 10 progressive stages. Output is a stage index (0 = below all, 1…N = highest step passed). Drive Image Chain slots, Chain Pick (rotation/opacity/scale), text visibility, glow triggers, or any numeric input — not images only.

properties.label: Input value
properties.help: Battery %, signal, RPM, CPU, temperature — any scalar.

properties.label: Active steps
properties.help: Only the first N thresholds are evaluated (1–10).

properties.label: Mode
choice_labels: Exact band (step i if t[i] ≤ v < t[i+1])
properties.help: Progressive: classic battery bars (must clear lower steps). Highest: last threshold the value meets. Exact band: one stage at a time between cut-points.

properties.label: Below all →
properties.help: Output when the value is under every active threshold (usually 0).

properties.label: Step 1 ≥
properties.help: Stage 1 becomes active when input ≥ this (and previous steps also passed, in progressive mode).

properties.label: Step 2 ≥
properties.help: Stage 2 becomes active when input ≥ this (and previous steps also passed, in progressive mode).

properties.label: Step 3 ≥
properties.help: Stage 3 becomes active when input ≥ this (and previous steps also passed, in progressive mode).

properties.label: Step 4 ≥
properties.help: Stage 4 becomes active when input ≥ this (and previous steps also passed, in progressive mode).

properties.label: Step 5 ≥
properties.help: Stage 5 becomes active when input ≥ this (and previous steps also passed, in progressive mode).

properties.label: Step 6 ≥
properties.help: Stage 6 becomes active when input ≥ this (and previous steps also passed, in progressive mode).

properties.label: Step 7 ≥
properties.help: Stage 7 becomes active when input ≥ this (and previous steps also passed, in progressive mode).

properties.label: Step 8 ≥
properties.help: Stage 8 becomes active when input ≥ this (and previous steps also passed, in progressive mode).

properties.label: Step 9 ≥
properties.help: Stage 9 becomes active when input ≥ this (and previous steps also passed, in progressive mode).

properties.label: Step 10 ≥
properties.help: Stage 10 becomes active when input ≥ this (and previous steps also passed, in progressive mode).

plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
  local v = {value}
  if type(v) ~= 'number' then v = tonumber(v) or 0 end
  local count = math.floor({steps_count} + 0.5)
  if count < 1 then count = 1 elseif count > 10 then count = 10 end
  local t = { {t1}, {t2}, {t3}, {t4}, {t5}, {t6}, {t7}, {t8}, {t9}, {t10} }
  local mode = '{mode}'
  if mode == 'exact_band' then
    for i = 1, count do
      local lo = t[i]
      local hi = (i < count) and t[i + 1] or nil
      if type(lo) ~= 'number' then lo = tonumber(lo) or 0 end
      if hi ~= nil and type(hi) ~= 'number' then hi = tonumber(hi) end
      if v >= lo and (hi == nil or v < hi) then return i end
    end
    -- above last threshold → last step
    local last = t[count]
    if type(last) ~= 'number' then last = tonumber(last) or 0 end
    if v >= last then return count end
    return {none_value}
  end
  if mode == 'highest' then
    local best = 0
    for i = 1, count do
      local th = t[i]
      if type(th) ~= 'number' then th = tonumber(th) or 0 end
      if v >= th then best = i end
    end
    if best == 0 then return {none_value} end
    return best
  end
  -- progressive (default): require contiguous pass from step 1
  local active = 0
  for i = 1, count do
    local th = t[i]
    if type(th) ~= 'number' then th = tonumber(th) or 0 end
    if v >= th then active = i else break end
  end
  if active == 0 then return {none_value} end
  return active
end)()
